description: For project closeout, this log form records completion criteria, outstanding work, commissioning, record documents, owner training, and final inspections. Its supporting evidence includes test reports, certificates, as-builts, manuals, photos, punch verification, and agency approvals.

use_case: Use the log form during construction project turnover and closeout when the project closeout record must identify contract deliverables, systems, spaces, warranties, training, keys, spare parts, and financial records. Complete the applicable handoff for owner receipt, final completion determination, warranty start, archive index, financial reconciliation, and responsibility handoff.
